definitions.explanation: An eye condition in which the lens becomes cloudy, blurring vision; common with age and treated by surgery.

examples.japanese: {白内障|はくないしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧。

examples.english: My grandmother says her vision is blurry because of cataracts.

examples.japanese: {白内障|はくないしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Since having cataract surgery, my father can read the newspaper clearly.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白内障|はくないしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to have cataract surgery
- {白内障|はくないしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to develop cataracts
- {老人性|ろうじんせい}{白内障|はくないしょう}: age-related cataract

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with {緑内障|りょくないしょう} (glaucoma), damage to the optic nerve usually linked to eye pressure. The two names differ only in the color word.
